Drone Strikes Hit Khartoum, Damaging Homes and UN Premises

Drone strikes attributed to the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) have hit the Sudanese capital, Khartoum, damaging civilian homes and United Nations premises. The exact number of casualties remains unclear. The conflict in Sudan has led to widespread civil war.
